title: Using 3SDPwoU for Block Ciphers
summary: 3SDPwoU has been applied to stream ciphers, but whether it can be used for block ciphers remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: The three-subset division property without unknown subset ($\text{3SDPwoU}$) was applied to stream ciphers by splitting the input space into two parts according to whether $s_u=0$ or $s_u=1$; this removes the unknown subset but means that the key can no longer be ignored. The unresolved task is to determine whether $\text{3SDPwoU}$ can be used for block ciphers.

scope.domain: Division-property cryptanalysis of stream and block ciphers.
parameters: s_u: value used to split the input space into the cases 0 and 1
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether 3SDPwoU can be used for block ciphers.

citations.label: Lower Bounds on the Degree of Block Ciphers

progress.summary: The source presents 3SDPwoU as a technique applied to stream ciphers and notes that its possible use for block ciphers was mentioned but left as an open problem.
citation_labels: Phil Hebborn et al., Lower Bounds on the Degree of Block Ciphers
